body:
Smoked 0.2 grams with a cigarette of 20x extract while waiting for a tea brew of yerba mate, spearmint leafs and fennel seeds with half a gram of 20x extract. Very slow onset about 45 minutes before any affect. Started with a very mild headache and funny dirt like taste in my mouth and a dirt like smell.
After drinking 12 oz of the tea I had to go up to the hospital with my wife. So setting was not very exciting but my mind set was good. I experienced almost like a mushroom high. The onset took about 1-2 hours and the high lasted about 2 hours.
The onset took about 1-2 hours and the high lasted about 2 hours.
My reason and purpose for taking this experience was to go on a dream walk. So by the time I got home I was already past the point of plateau, and was not feeling like drinking any more tea. The teas taste was good and I double brewed it to ensure that the extract was dissolved.
